Open primefashiongent.com in a browser: real shop with products, prices and a legal notice with BE0... number, or an unedited theme/demo?

summary: Nothing about this Gent clothing merchant could be verified automatically: the KBO search and the declared website were both blocked for the verifier, and no directory, social, register-aggregator or review trace of a 'Prime Fashion' business in Gent was found; the domain only surfaces as the name of a WordPress theme. No adverse reports. 0 risk points, all unverified, but the complete absence of footprint plus personal gmail and no product description warrants a manual KYB check (KBO number, live website, shop address).
